summary: Vancouver, aerospace engineer, strong preference for Linux and BSD over Windows, critical of JavaScript and modern web practices, advocates for privacy and open-source software, enjoys flight simulators, has a brother, critical of corporate culture and advertising, skeptical of government surveillance, identifies as a libertarian, has a strong interest in programming languages (especially Lisp and Fortran), dislikes systemd, prefers Emacs as a text editor, has experience with power management in Linux, and has a critical view of mainstream media and technology companies.
